newsitem.title: USA: MobileMedia seeks stay of FCC hearing.
newsitem.headline: MobileMedia seeks stay of FCC hearing.

text.p: MobileMedia Corp said on Thursday it filed a motion with the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) seeking a suspension of the hearings proceeding instituted by the FCC on April 7.

The FCC earlier this month ordered a hearing into the paging company's qualifications to retain its licenses after finding that at least 289 forms filed with the agency allegedly misrepresented the status of paging stations.
The company, which is continuing operations under a U.S. Bankruptcy Court's debtor in possession facility, said it could be fined or lose its license if it loses the FCC case.
The stay filed with the FCC includes a motion which describes the effect on its debt and equity holders of the case. (( Nick Louth, New York Newsroom 212 859 1712))
